methodology.shop: Price, only when Slot is configured and ShopWeight > 0
methodology.producer: Per refreshed batch, full-price diamond cost = ItemSpeedUpCost + (StorageSpeedUpCost - ItemSpeedUpCost) / (StorageMaxNumber / ItemMaxNumber). For a target level L, expected usable target pieces are computed recursively from direct outputs at levels <= L: a level-k output contributes 1 / 2^(L-k) target pieces; higher-level outputs are not treated as divisible into lower-level pieces. Target-item diamonds and energy divide the batch cost by that expected target-piece count.
methodology.weighting: Fixed producers draw from the configured weighted list on every click. Weight_i determines probability Weight_i / sum(Weight), not inventory consumption. On the normal click path itemRestNumber decreases by exactly 1; the batch therefore allows ItemMaxNumber clicks. Outputs from other series still consume the same batch inventory.
methodology.inventory: At initial/opened state itemRestNumber = ItemMaxNumber and storageRestNumber = StorageMaxNumber. On the normal click path each click subtracts exactly 1 from itemRestNumber. When itemRestNumber is zero, the ordinary ItemRecoveryDuration runs; after it, itemRestNumber resets to ItemMaxNumber and storageRestNumber decreases by ItemMaxNumber. When storageRestNumber reaches zero, StorageRecoveryDuration runs and both layers refill to their configured maxima.
methodology.exclusions: Theoretical long-run full-price acceleration of every item and storage cooldown; excludes free waiting, partially elapsed cooldown discounts, buffs, board constraints, and value of other-series outputs. Energy counts configured CostEnergy per click; actual play may differ.
methodology.order_coin: Standard order coin value is the sum of OrderItemConfig.Price for each required piece. Baseline orders use RecommendedPrice when present. Player level controls eligibility, not the configured value; buffs and special order modes may alter the final reward.
methodology.cooldown_price: For the active phase, remaining_fraction = max(0, (phase_end - server_time) / phase_duration). Current diamond cost = max(ceil(remaining_fraction * phase_speedup_cost), 1). Opened state uses ItemSpeedUpCost unless storageRestNumber is zero, in which case it uses StorageSpeedUpCost; initializing/opening use their own configured costs.
methodology.second_order: Type 805 (处理过的海鲜) is a disposable secondary generator, not a one-shot conversion. Its configured ItemMaxNumber is 12 and each normal click costs CostEnergy=1, draws the 901/902 pool independently at 95%/5%, and consumes one remaining charge; it disappears only when remaining charges reach zero. For an actual lifecycle with N successful charge consumptions, expected 901/902 counts are 0.95N/0.05N and expected level-1-equivalent output is 1.05N. N=12 is the nominal full-charge case. The generic CosetRestNumber function has a multi-decrement branch, but the decompiled evidence does not show ordinary Type 805 clicks, ordinary item/storage cooldowns, or energy acceleration passing k>1; do not infer a multi-charge 805 path without a confirmed caller. Upstream cost is the cost of producing one level-5 Series 8 item (16 base items).

special_conversions.uses_formula: N = 实际生命周期内成功消耗的剩余次数；普通逐次点击且满额生成时 N=12
